# isValidSlideId

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is a slide id.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isValidSlideId() — Checks whether a value is a slide id. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isValidSlideId(value: unknown): value is string;
```

Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at least one of them. Slide ids are short — `p1` is a perfectly ordinary one — so no minimum length is imposed.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is a slide id; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `value` to `string` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isValidSlideId("p1"); // => true
isValidSlideId("SLIDES_api123"); // => true
isValidSlideId("has space"); // => false
isValidSlideId(""); // => false
```
